title: OpenAI IPO won't happen this year, says Sam Altman
summary: "Given everything happening with safety, right now would be an ill-advised moment to go public," OpenAI CEO Sam Altman told Fortune.

title: Bitcoin Suisse plans to cut up to half its Swiss jobs as it shifts work abroad
summary: The company is closing its Copenhagen IT site while maintaining Bratislava and opening a new hub in Vietnam to reduce costs.

title: Nigel Farage’s Reform UK lands $97 million donations from two crypto billionaires in 24 hours
summary: The combined haul equals the largest individual political donations in U.K. history, sharply scaling up crypto industry backing.

title: Anthropic CEO calls for AI race to slow down citing safety. Musk and OpenAI's Altman agrees
summary: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei, OpenAI’s Sam Altman and Elon Musk have agreed on an unusual position: frontier AI development may need to slow as systems become capable of helping build their own successors.

title: Ripple stablecoin chief sees $13 trillion corporate treasury opportunity for RLUSD
summary: Payments and capital markets are driving growth for Ripple's $2.4 billion digital dollar as it looks to bring RLUSD to Europe under MiCA, the firm's Jack McDonald said.
